generation_guards: Generate exactly one candle and exactly one croissant.
Ensure the candle is clearly in front of the croissant, with the croissant behind it.
Make the croissant spotted and ensure the spots are visible.
Keep both objects visible; avoid hiding the candle or fully occluding the croissant.
initial_plan.generation_strategy: Use a simple two-object composition with clear depth ordering: one candle in the foreground and one spotted croissant behind it. Emphasize visibility, count accuracy, and the front/back spatial relationship.
initial_plan.initial_prompt: Create an image with exactly one candle in the foreground, clearly positioned in front of exactly one spotted croissant. The croissant should be behind the candle and visibly spotted. Both the candle and the croissant must be clearly visible, with the candle not obscured and the croissant only partially overlapped if necessary to show the candle is in front. No additional candles or croissants.
